Results

Major adverse cardiovascular events, as each trial defines them. These 3 trials are NOT pooled, and the reason is stated rather than the outcome being quietly omitted: THE THREE TRIALS DO NOT SHARE AN ENDPOINT. Decomposed into components and compared as SETS rather than by name, the union is TEN components and exactly ONE -- cardiovascular death -- is common to all three. RESUSCITATED CARDIAC ARREST is in COLCOT and in neither of the others: a whole component present in one arm of the comparison and absent from the rest. MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION is ANY in COLCOT, SPONTANEOUS (NONPROCEDURAL) ONLY in LoDoCo2, and RECURRENT in CLEAR SYNERGY -- and LoDoCo2's qualifier EXCLUDES periprocedural infarction in a literature where a large share of infarctions are periprocedural. STROKE is ANY TYPE in COLCOT and CLEAR SYNERGY and ISCHAEMIC ONLY in LoDoCo2; colchicine's effect in intracerebral haemorrhage is an open question with its own reading in this split, so a trial counting only ischaemic strokes and a trial counting every stroke are measuring the drug against different risks. REVASCULARISATION requires an URGENT HOSPITALISATION FOR ANGINA in COLCOT, is ISCHAEMIA-DRIVEN in LoDoCo2, and is UNPLANNED AND ISCHAEMIA-DRIVEN in CLEAR SYNERGY. A pool of these three would report a number for a quantity no trial measured.1

Risk of bias in the included results

Risk of bias was assessed with RoB 2. The unit of assessment is a result1

This limb is REFUSED, and the state recorded is: NOT_ASSESSED_FOR_THIS_REVIEW2

Why it is refused: No result-level RoB 2 assessment has been performed. RECORDED AS UNASSESSED, NEVER AS ABSENT OF BIAS: an unassessed domain is NOT_ASSESSABLE, not LOW.3

What would close it: RoB 2 per RESULT for each of the three contributing results.4

what_the_drop_from_42_to_3_meansIT IS A FINDING OF THE SEARCH, NOT OF THE SCREEN. Thirty-nine eligible trials have run or are running and have published no primary result this pass could read. Per PAGE-STANDARD.md a body of eligible-but-unreported trials means the query is well aimed and the field is still in flight -- and the disposition split sharpens it: 53 of the 137 are COMPLETED, TERMINATED or WITHDRAWN with NOTHING posted to the registry, against 33 that have genuinely not reported yet. Those two states were separated deliberately, because folded together they read as a field still in flight when half of it is not.
and_the_registration_count_is_not_a_study_countNCT04906720 and NCT06731595 are ONE trial under two registration ids -- identical official title, org identifier, enrolment 248, dates, status and conditions. 137 is a count of REGISTRATIONS and at most 136 studies.

Analysis output — ABSENT_AND_THAT_IS_THE_FINDING

k=3 and nothing was pooled, so there is NO model call to quote, NO pooled estimate, NO heterogeneity and NO package version. This is not a missing artefact; it is the correct state for a topic with no synthesis.

What stands instead: —
Provenance: —
—

Heterogeneity: Undefined: no between-study variance was estimated because no model was run.
What would change it: An estimand shared by two or more included trials. Where k is already above 1 and nothing pooled, the obstacle is the ESTIMAND rather than the evidence base, and this field must say which.

Published-meta comparison — PENDING_EXTERNAL_RESOLUTION

Denominator: —. Not yet established. Establishing it requires resolving published syntheses' included-sets to REGISTRATION IDs. A second lane has validated that pipeline (stated-k table identification plus two-hop citation->PMID->registration) and is running it now.

Explicitly not done: CITATION-STRING MATCHING. It would produce a comparison-shaped answer tonight and it is not identity: two syntheses citing the same trial under different labels would read as different, and the same label on different trials as the same. That is the substitution class this project audits for.

Blocked on: lane 2 registration-id resolution
